scripts.build: pnpm python:install && pnpm python:playwright:install && pnpm -r --if-present build
scripts.check:js: pnpm lint && pnpm typecheck && pnpm test && pnpm -r --if-present build
scripts.check:python: uv run --project python-app ruff check python-app && uv run --project python-app mypy --config-file python-app/pyproject.toml python-app/app && uv run --project python-app pytest python-app/tests
scripts.python:playwright:install: uv run --project python-app playwright install chromium
scripts.cmux:skills: mkdir -p ~/.claude/skills && cp -R python-app/app/live/actor/cmux/skills/cmux-browser ~/.claude/skills/ && (cmux browser profiles list | grep -q '^agent' || cmux browser profiles add agent)
